config.name: reservedCapacity.zoneLevel
config.description: whether enables host capacity reserve on zone level

config.name: reservedCapacity.clusterLevel
config.description: whether enables host capacity reserve on clsuter level

config.name: reservedCapacity.hostLevel
config.description: whether enables host capacity reserve on host level

config.name: paginationLimit
config.description: allocation limit when pagination is enabled

config.name: hostAllocator.checkHostMem
config.description: whether check vm memory size with host physical memory size

config.name: migration.differentOs
config.description: true allows vm to migrate between hosts with different operating systems

config.name: physicalServer.cpu.safetyBuffer.percent
config.description: percentage of total cpu reserved as safety buffer on each PhysicalServer. Subtracted from PhysicalServerCapacityVO.availableCpu only on mixed-deployment hosts (>1 role); also used by ContainerNodeCordonService.evaluate as the cordon hysteresis cushion. Effective buffer = max(4, totalCpu * percent / 100).

config.name: physicalServer.memory.safetyBuffer.percent
config.description: percentage of total memory reserved as safety buffer on each PhysicalServer. Subtracted from PhysicalServerCapacityVO.availableMemory only on mixed-deployment hosts (>1 role); also used by ContainerNodeCordonService.evaluate as the cordon hysteresis cushion. Effective buffer = max(4GiB, totalMemory * percent / 100).
